text_block_list.text:
Today marks the start of Нарита Таисин's
journey
to take on the Twinkle Series.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
To show off her amazing final sprint, and
to get
the better of all those who
underestimate her...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We must first work together towards her
debut.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
